visible_selection_evidence.target: Among Terminal-Bar cases whose T2 is still pending at T+5, first T2 hit from T+6 through T+20.
visible_selection_evidence.interpretation: Visible Train/Validation evidence supports a five-bar full-PRZ-exit deadline, not a monotonic speed advantage inside the five-bar window.

claim: A full PRZ exit within five bars, rather than exit speed inside that window, is associated with higher later Type-I T2 progression.

population.eligibility: Terminal event is mature for the 20-bar reaction horizon and T2 remains pending at T+5.
population.split: Only the already-sealed M2.17 Holdout is eligible for the confirmatory evaluation.

exposure.name: full_prz_exit_by_t5
exposure.definition: T2 pending at T+5 and a full PRZ exit occurs at least once from T+1 through T+5.

comparator.name: no_full_exit_by_t5
comparator.definition: T2 pending at T+5 and no full PRZ exit occurs from T+1 through T+5.

primary_contrast.endpoint: First T2 hit from T+6 through T+20.
primary_contrast.effect_measure: absolute difference in endpoint proportions: exposure minus comparator

confirmatory_test.method: Newcombe score confidence interval for the difference of two independent proportions
confirmatory_test.success_criterion: lower bound of the 95% Newcombe interval for exposure-minus-comparator is > 0

secondary_diagnostics.role: descriptive only; they cannot rescue or overturn the primary confirmatory result

notes: This file is the repository-history pre-registration for the one-time M2.22 Holdout evaluation.
M2.21 must not read or summarize Holdout outcomes.
Any change to hypothesis, endpoint, comparator, sample floor or success criterion after this commit invalidates the confirmatory interpretation and requires a new untouched dataset version.
